ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Clarification of the assessment notations listed above: graduate students will be assessed $309 per credit hour; undergrad students will be assessed $277 per credit hour. All students will be assessed a $45 per credit hour administration fee. These assessments are in addition to the campus range assessments if students also take an on-campus class. Students will be required to attend proctored tests on 7/14 and 8/4, either on campus or at an approved location.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $309.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $277.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $45.00 per Bill Hour.
